newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Leykam surges 8.5 pct on job cut news.
newsitem.headline: Leykam surges 8.5 pct on job cut news.

text.p: Shares of paper maker Leykam Muerztaler, majority owned by Dutch KNP BT, surged 8.5 percent in early trading on Thursday after the group said it would cut some 500 jobs at its Austrian plant.
At 1015 GMT, the shares were up 23 schillings at 294. The ATX index of 21 blue chips was up 0.54 percent at 1,186.67 at the same time.
"It's always been good for shares when they say they'll cut jobs," said a trader.

KNP on Wednesday said it would cut a total of 1,000 jobs at its production facilities across Europe. The reorganisation, part of a 1.2 billion guilders investment programme, would result cost savings of 100 million guilders per year, it said.
